# graylog_lookup_caches (Data Source)

Lists Graylog lookup caches. Nested `config` is a JSON string (Plugin Framework limitation); use `graylog_lookup_cache` for a typed object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_lookup_caches" "example" {}
```
